router_rationale: Behavior spans an HTTP POST controller that returns JSON — API level is the right fit. Unit testing OnboardingProcess::execute() would require mocking the entire Magento DI graph. E2E would be too brittle for this smoke check.
Regression in an external integration (Salesforce API). API-level test is the right layer — it can assert on the sf_case_id field in the order response without requiring Salesforce sandbox access.

MOQ enforcement is implemented in the checkout REST API pipeline. API-level tests can directly probe the rejection behavior by submitting orders with varying quantities and asserting HTTP status codes.

Payment method management is exposed via the Stripe Payments controller. API-level test covers the delete-with-open-order guard (PaymentMethods.php line 70-76) which has a specific, testable error message.

Admin OTP resend is a controller with session-based auth. API-level test can hit the endpoint and verify redirect behavior. Note: non-determinism flag raised — Resend.php uses rand() for OTP generation.
